title: An archetypal flow as the ideal layer: each stage a subdomain with its own tensions (2026-10-25)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Once we have the small issues done, I was to build on the report and our understanding.

I want to see if we can map out the high level archetypal flow. What are have we been trying to achieve at each stage. 

This is the ideal layer of the map. Then we start building on this spine. What were the problems what were our attempts to address them. 

Each stage in this flow is it's own subdomain. Each will have its own tensions. Let's see if we can build a fractal map. Sometimes we will have tried to go too far down one axis, but without realising what our tradeoff was.
